html.body: The main pathway for the degradation of fructose in the liver is via glycolysis. Before it can enter glycolysis, however, fructose has to unergo a series of enzymatic catalysis reactions, comprising a major part of fructose metabolism pathway. Galactose is also metabolized in the liver. The entry of galactose into glycolysis is mediated by an epimerization reaction of galactose 1-phosphate. free text=Biochemiscal Pathways - An Atlas of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology Edited by Gerhard Michal free text=Biochemistry by Voet and Voet free text=Color Atlas of Biochemistry by Jan Koolman and Klaus-Heinrich Rohm
